title: 第21章 师兄的实力究竟到了何等逆天的程度第22章 本座得亲自去寻它一趟了
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
“怎会到了第二重？”
“这功法晦涩难懂，当初我刚刚上山习练之际经过师尊指点才在三月后领悟些许，她怎会在无人指点的情况下三日就领悟到了第二重？”
“不可能，绝对不可能。”
其余峰主也纷纷开口。
毕竟这事儿太匪夷所思了。
三天时间不仅领悟，还领悟到了第二重。
说出去没人会相信。
而林清瑶此刻也是懵逼的。
先前她获得《青霄蕴灵诀》时，玄辉真人只说这本功法是一本上乘的筑基功法。
可从未说过这功法很难习练。
所以自始至终林清瑶都认为这本功法就是一本普通的上乘功法罢了。
可此刻听到这些峰主的话语，她才反应过来。
这功法竟然是天衍宗千年来没人能自行领悟的功法。
而且就连这些峰主在有人指点的情况下习练时也需几月时间。
要知道，一本功法的领悟难度决定了功法的强弱。
就比如当初林清瑶还在外门之时习练的功法，那本功法凭借她的天资只需看一遍就能领悟。
就算是他们大炎王朝的高阶功法，她也只需多看几遍就有明悟之感。
可唯独这本《青霄蕴灵诀》领悟时，让她第一次感觉到了晦涩难懂至极。
所以那日她才会急的哭出来。
原本她只以为自己的悟性太低，可现在听雷震峰峰主的话后她明白了。

不是她悟性低，是这本功法难领悟到了极点！
以至于这些峰主听到后都各个不敢相信。
同时，她也知道自己并非什么天骄，她能领悟这本功法，全部得益于陆鸣的指点。
若没有陆鸣，就算给她三百天，她也不见得能领悟。
念及于此，林清瑶望向走回小院的陆鸣，眼中再度出现了震撼之感。
那日，他记得陆鸣只是看了一眼这本功法就胸有成竹的点头，而且还说这本功法十分简单。
可今日，这些峰主却说这本功法晦涩难懂，连他们都需在有人指点的情况下领悟几月。
由此可见，陆鸣的悟性甚至在这些峰主之上！
顿时，林清瑶倒吸一口凉气，心中颤抖不已。
我师兄的实力究竟到了何等逆天的程度……
这么多峰主眼中晦涩难懂的功法，在他眼中竟然落了个“十分简单”
的评价。
恐怖，太恐怖了。
玄辉真人也是满眼的匪夷所思，按照他的常识来说，他根本不相信林清瑶的话。
但先前，林清瑶几日时间从炼气十重突破到筑基六重，这足以证明她的悟性逆天。
所以，此事或许有那么一点可能性。
玄辉真人压下震惊，问道：“清瑶，你当真将《青霄蕴灵诀》领悟到了第二重？”
林清瑶面对质疑，神色不变，拱手道：“弟子不敢欺瞒。”
“好，既如此……”
content_en:
"How did it reach the second level?"
"This technique is obscure and difficult to understand. When I first went up the mountain to practice, I only understood it a little after three months after being guided by my master. How could she understand the second level in three days without anyone's guidance?"
"No way, absolutely impossible."
The other peak masters also spoke one after another.
After all, this is so incredible.
In three days, I not only realized it, but also realized the second level.
No one will believe it if you tell me.
And Lin Qingyao was also confused at the moment.
When she obtained the "Qingxiao Yunling Jue" previously, Master Xuanhui only said that this technique was a superior foundation-building technique.
But I never said this technique was difficult to practice.
So from the beginning to the end, Lin Qingyao thought that this exercise book was just an ordinary and superior exercise book.
But now she heard the words of these peak masters and she reacted.
This technique turned out to be one that no one in the Tianyan Sect had been able to comprehend on their own for thousands of years.
Moreover, it would take several months for these peak masters to practice under the guidance of someone.
You must know that the difficulty of comprehending a skill determines its strength.
For example, the technique that Lin Qingyao practiced when she was still in the outer sect could be understood by her talent only after reading it once.
Even for the high-level techniques of their Great Yan Dynasty, she only needed to read them a few times to feel enlightened.
But it was only when she understood the "Qingxiao Yunling Jue" that she felt it was extremely obscure and difficult to understand for the first time.
That's why she burst into tears that day.
Originally she thought her understanding was too low, but now she understood after listening to the words of the Master of Lei Zhen Peak.
It's not that her understanding is low, it's that this technique is extremely difficult to comprehend!
So much so that none of these peak masters could believe it after hearing it.
At the same time, she also knew that she was not a genius. She was able to understand this technique only because of Lu Ming's guidance.
Without Lu Ming, even if she was given three hundred days, she might not be able to understand.
Thinking of this, Lin Qingyao looked at Lu Ming who was walking back to the small courtyard, and there was a sense of shock in her eyes again.
On that day, he remembered that Lu Ming just glanced at this technique and nodded confidently, and also said that this technique was very simple.
But today, these peak masters said that this technique is difficult to understand, and even they need someone to guide them for several months to understand it.
It can be seen that Lu Ming's understanding is even higher than that of these peak masters!
Suddenly, Lin Qingyao took a breath of cold air and trembled in her heart.
How incredible is my senior brother's strength...
There are so many techniques that are obscure and difficult to understand in the eyes of the peak masters, but in his eyes, "very simple"
evaluation.
Horrible, so terrible.
Master Xuanhui was also filled with bewilderment. According to his common sense, he didn't believe Lin Qingyao's words at all.
But previously, Lin Qingyao had broken through from the tenth level of Qi Refining to the sixth level of Foundation Building in a few days, which was enough to prove that her understanding was incredible.
Therefore, this matter may have some possibility.
Master Xuanhui suppressed his shock and asked: "Qingyao, have you really understood the "Qingxiao Yunling Jue" to the second level?"
When Lin Qingyao faced the doubt, her expression remained unchanged, and she cupped her hands and said, "Disciple does not dare to deceive."
"Okay, that's it..."
